# Ospeli

> Ospeli is an open-core, offline-first healthcare operations platform. It records what happens in a hospital or clinic (beds, engineering faults and work orders, emergency department flow, process maps) as one event log, and helps staff fix the flow. The bed board is one module, not the product. People decide, Ospeli suggests: there are no clinical decision features, and every AI feature has an off switch. This public build runs on synthetic data only (a fictional "Example General Hospital").

## Try it
- [Live demo app](https://ospeli.com/app/): installable web app; works offline after the first load; synthetic data only.
- [Process mapping demo](https://ospeli.com/demo/process-map/): map a process step by step and test changes with a rule-based guide; read-only agent view at `window.ospeliProcessMap` (describe, get, analyse, suggestions); fictional data.
- [Emergency department flow preview](https://ospeli.com/demo/ed-flow/): anonymous patient timeline, pressure levels set by the site, action cards; read-only agent view at `window.ospeliEdFlowDemo`; fictional data.
- [Cleaning and portering preview](https://ospeli.com/demo/support-tasks/): porter and cleaner task lists, ward requests, helpdesk by team; read-only agent view at `window.ospeliSupportTasksDemo`; fictional data.
- [Incidents and actions preview](https://ospeli.com/demo/actions/): staff reports, learning review, one action tracker, risk register; read-only agent view at `window.ospeliActionsDemo`; fictional data.
- [Stores and stock preview](https://ospeli.com/demo/stores-stock/): ward stock reports, storekeeper pick list, supply view; read-only agent view at `window.ospeliStoresDemo`; fictional data.
- [Daily operations report preview](https://ospeli.com/demo/daily-report/): decisions for today, run charts, bottleneck finder, huddle list; read-only agent view at `window.ospeliDailyReportDemo`; fictional data.
- [Theatres and procedure lists preview](https://ospeli.com/demo/theatres/): Case times on one timeline, session use, cancellations on the day with reasons, and tomorrow's readiness: bed, kit and checklist. Fictional data.
- [Outpatients and clinics preview](https://ospeli.com/demo/clinics/): Clinic reception on a phone, the referral waiting list and free slots for booking, and utilisation and did-not-attend for the manager. Fictional data.
- [Facilities and utilities preview](https://ospeli.com/demo/facilities/): Report a building fault by room or QR code, technician job queues by trade, planned maintenance, utility checks and a plant status board. Fictional data.
- [Staffing, rosters and credentials preview](https://ospeli.com/demo/staffing/): My shifts and swaps on a phone, the unit roster as booked against planned, and today and tonight across units, measured as cover, never by person. Fictional data.
- [Patient transport and transfers preview](https://ospeli.com/demo/transport/): Book a transfer from the ward, a dispatch desk with vehicles and crews, crew status on a phone, and fleet checks for the manager. Fictional data.
- [Diagnostics: imaging and laboratory preview](https://ospeli.com/demo/diagnostics/): Where each sample or scan is, step by step; lab reception, imaging bookings, equipment status and turnaround by step. Never shows results. Fictional data.
- [Emergency preparedness and continuity preview](https://ospeli.com/demo/continuity/): Readiness checklists, a printable downtime pack, incident mode with action cards and a decision log, and a switch to show it keeps working offline. Fictional data.
- [Pharmacy operations preview](https://ospeli.com/demo/pharmacy/): Ward requests and discharge medicines status, a dispensary queue by stage, and turnaround, stock and expiry for the manager. Never chooses medicines or doses. Fictional data.
- [Patient experience and feedback preview](https://ospeli.com/demo/feedback/): A three-question card for patients and visitors, themes and "you said, we did" for department leads, and complaints by stage and due date. Fictional data.
- [IT, digital and cyber preview](https://ospeli.com/demo/it-digital/): Report an IT problem, a systems status banner, a service desk queue with downtime switches, and access reviews and an audit view for the data protection lead. Fictional data.
- [Finance and budgets preview](https://ospeli.com/demo/finance/): A budget holder's month against plan with the reasons behind it, variance notes for the finance partner, and cost per occupied bed day for leadership. Fictional data.
- [Infection prevention operations preview](https://ospeli.com/demo/infection-prevention/): Isolation rooms by status, requests matched to rooms, quick audits on a phone, and closure mode with beds lost as counts. No diagnoses. Fictional data.
- [Governance, policies and accreditation preview](https://ospeli.com/demo/governance/): Find the current policy in seconds, owners' review dates, read-and-understood coverage, a self-assessment grid and meeting packs that feed one action list. Fictional data.
- [Critical care capacity preview](https://ospeli.com/demo/critical-care/): Beds by state, step-downs waiting for a ward bed, and capacity refusals and transfers out. The clinical team decides; Ospeli records the flow. Fictional data.
- [Primary and community care preview](https://ospeli.com/demo/community/): Home visit rounds and clinic lists that work without signal, follow-ups by programme, centre stock, and community places for hospital discharges. Fictional data.
- [Planning, business cases and capital projects preview](https://ospeli.com/demo/projects/): Milestones and weekly updates, a portfolio with the reason behind every status, a business case builder and benefits measured from live data. Fictional data.
- [Maternity and children's services flow preview](https://ospeli.com/demo/maternity/): Labour rooms, postnatal beds, cots and children's beds by state, transfers between units and sites, and closures logged with reason and role. Fictional data.
- [Mental health and long-stay beds preview](https://ospeli.com/demo/long-stay/): Patients ready to leave with days waiting and the reason, placement requests by stage, and bed days lost and out-of-area placements as counts. Fictional data.
- [Health records and information preview](https://ospeli.com/demo/records/): Tomorrow's clinic pull list on a phone, chart moves by scan or tap, the coding backlog, and record requests by due date. Fictional data.
- [Revenue cycle (optional) preview](https://ospeli.com/demo/revenue/): For organisations that bill payers: coverage at the front desk, claims ready or missing something, and denials by reason. Off by default; never affects care. Fictional data.
- [Public health operations preview](https://ospeli.com/demo/public-health/): Outreach sessions that work without signal, stock and expiry by site, cold chain readings and alarms, and people reached against the local target. Fictional data.
- [All 30 areas](https://ospeli.com/areas/): what each area of hospital operations will do, who uses it, what it records, its measures and its AI assistant commands; spec in https://ospeli.com/areas/areas.json.
- [Front page](https://ospeli.com/): what Ospeli is, its modules, how a pilot runs, and its governance rules.

## For agents
- [Agent guide](https://ospeli.com/agents.md): how an AI agent may use Ospeli, and what it may not do.
- [Command API (readable)](https://ospeli.com/app/api/README.md): every action in the app as a named command, with roles and whether a person must approve.
- [Command API (JSON)](https://ospeli.com/app/api/commands.json): input and output JSON schemas and an example for every command.

## Rules
- Synthetic data only in this build. Never send real patient, staff or hospital data to the demo.
- People decide, Ospeli suggests. Agents may read and propose; a person accepts or declines.
- Agent access is off by default, per hospital and per ward, and only people can switch it on.
- Every agent action is audited with actor type "agent", the agent's name and the role it acts for.
- Patient data stays on site: Ospeli is designed to run on the hospital's own devices or server, never through a cloud relay. Today the demo runs in your browser and its data stays on that device. FHIR and CSV export, and sync between devices, are planned, not built.
- Measure flows, never people.
